C1631.title: BAYC Discord Phishing Attack Leads to NFT Theft
C1631.summary: In June 2022, BAYC's official Discord server was briefly compromised, allowing hackers to post phishing links that resulted in the theft of NFTs worth approximately 200 ETH. The stolen assets were transferred to multiple addresses, with some funds moved to Tornado Cash.
